title: USTR Greer Urges G20 Nations to Back Trump Tariff Agenda, Takes Aim at China
detail: US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer urged G20 nations to back Trump's tariff agenda and took direct aim at China's trade practices, signaling continued escalation of trade pressure ahead of the midterm elections.

title: Hegseth Announces New Drone Command, 20% Cut to Senior Military Commanders
detail: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth delivered a 'State of the Force' speech announcing the creation of a new drone command and cuts to 20% of senior military commanders (generals and flag officers), framing the sweeping restructuring as modernization for future warfare.

title: Trump Administration Appeals Ruling Blocking Student Visa Limits
detail: The Trump administration filed an appeal against a court ruling that had blocked its restrictions on international student visas, escalating the legal fight over immigration and higher education policy. The appeal signals the administration's intent to press forward with limits that universities and advocacy groups say would devastate foreign enrollment.

title: India Under Modi Openly Challenges Trump on Terrorism Definitions and Tariffs
detail: India under Prime Minister Narendra Modi is increasingly and openly pushing back against Trump administration positions on terrorism definitions and tariffs, signaling a notable shift in US-India relations. The friction marks a departure from the closer alignment of Trump's first term and underscores how New Delhi is reasserting independent foreign policy stances amid ongoing trade tensions.
